title: Zombie Drift: Steel Rage
raw_description: Zombie Drift: Steel Rage is a post-apocalyptic 3D action game that mixes arcade drifting with arena survival. Drive an armored battle car into a ruined city arena full of zombie hordes and mutant giants. Speed and controlled slides are your weapons: the sharper the drift, the faster your nitro rage builds and the harder your spiked bumper hits - up to 2.5x ramming damage. Mow down walkers and runners, blow up barrels and collect scrap gears. Campaign of 100 levels in 10 chapters with 20 titan bosses, plus endless survival mode. Unlock the Iron Fang, the Dune Reaper buggy and the heavy War Titan, upgrade armor and turbo, and pick weapon modules between waves: miniguns, buzzsaws, flamethrowers and rocket mortars.

title: Super Nitro Racing 3
raw_description: Super Nitro Racing 3 is a top down racer with 21 tracks and very little room to relax. The car accelerates on its own, so your job is steering, braking and finding the right line. Charge the nitro bar to full and it fires in one long burst, then you have to earn it again. Rain, snow and fog change how much grip you get, and the icy sections will spit you into the barriers if you get greedy. Damage never repairs by itself, grab the D pods on track to fix the car. Five modes to play: Time Attack, Race against three rivals, Ghost, Survival and Championship.
